products.notes: Waist sizes in inches. Stretch cotton.

policies.delivery: Standard delivery takes 3-5 working days and costs 4.00. Free delivery on orders over 60.00. Express delivery (1-2 working days) costs 9.00. We do not ship internationally yet.
policies.returns: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a refund to the original payment method. Sale items are final sale. Customer pays return shipping unless the item is faulty.
policies.exchange: Size or colour exchanges are free within 14 days if the new item is in stock. Contact the shop to arrange it.
policies.payment: We accept credit/debit cards and cash on delivery for orders under 100.00.
policies.hours: The shop is open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00. Closed on Sundays.
